work.title: Untitled (Diptych Collages)
work.description: Installation view of two framed collages hung side by side on a grey wall. Both works incorporate black borders, white grounds, and mixed fragments including orange, magenta, and black elements; the right panel features a prominent bullseye and concentric target rings.
work.composition: two framed works side by side
keywords: orange magenta black white collage diptych
